name: Loma Linda University Health Murrieta Volunteers
what_you_do: Help at the Loma Linda University Health site in Murrieta. You give 100 hours in a year. You also go to a first meeting and required training.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 16. Teens must send a sealed transcript that shows a GPA of 3.2 or better.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the link on the Murrieta page. Make sure you pick the Murrieta form.
notes: You can call or email with any questions. Phone: 951-704-1355. Email: volunteersmurrieta@llu.edu.
